title: Left-homotopy edge quotient and its triangle calculus
statement: Use simplicial sets, quasicategories, standard simplices and degeneracies of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $D$ be a quasicategory in a fixed universe, and let $1_x=s_0x$ denote its degenerate edge at $x$. For parallel edges $f,f':x\to y$, define $f\sim_L f'$ to mean that there is a $2$-simplex with edges $f$ on $[0,1]$, $1_y$ on $[1,2]$, and $f'$ on $[0,2]$. This is an equivalence relation on each set of parallel edges. Let $H_L(D)$ have vertices as objects and morphism sets $\operatorname{Edge}_D(x,y)/{\sim_L}$; write $q(f)$ for the class of $f$. These sets form an ordinary category with identity $q(1_x)$ and composition $q(g)\circ q(f)=q(k)$, where $k$ is the long edge of any filler of the inner $2$-horn with successive edges $f,g$. The composition is independent of the representatives and the filler. For edges $f:x\to y$, $g:y\to z$, $h:x\to z$, one has $q(g)\circ q(f)=q(h)$ if and only if a $2$-simplex has precisely boundary edges $f,g,h$ in these positions. This statement concerns the quotient of edges by $\sim_L$, without identifying it with a category presented by edge words.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: take A to be the 2-truncation of D. Mathlib has no instance making it a Quasicategory₂; fill21, fill31 and fill32 (class at TwoTruncated.lean:54-71) come from Quasicategory.hornFilling (Quasicategory/Basic.lean:44) applied to the horn maps glued from the given edges or triangles by horn₂₁.isPushout (SimplicialSet/HornColimits.lean:87), horn₃₁.exists_desc (HornColimits.lean:332) and horn₃₂.exists_desc (HornColimits.lean:420); the missing face of the filler is the required 2-simplex. Each clause is then already in TwoTruncated.lean: SSet.Truncated.HomotopicL at 78 defines the relation; SSet.Truncated.instSetoidEdge at 203 proves it an equivalence; SSet.Truncated.HomotopyCategory₂.Hom at 213 and SSet.Truncated.HomotopyCategory₂.instCategoryStruct at 220 construct the specified quotient and composition (independence of the representatives at 224-225, by Edge.CompStruct.comp_unique at 169); SSet.Truncated.instCategoryHomotopyCategory₂ at 300 proves the category laws; SSet.Truncated.HomotopyCategory₂.homMk_id at 252 gives identities; Edge.CompStruct.homotopyCategory₂_fac at 274 gives independence of the filler; SSet.Truncated.Edge.CompStruct.nonempty_iff at 295 proves the iff. These are one declaration per clause, with no path-presentation comparison claimed.
